content.description: Democratizing DePIN (Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network). hashtag What is Nuvola Digital? By investing the proceeds from the initial $NVL token sale into the underlying crypto assets and the hardware necessary for running their systems, Nuvola strengthens the decentralized ecosystem while ensuring a sustainable reward mechanism for its token holders. Crucially, Nuvola's robust node infrastructure plays a pivotal role in maintaining the integrity and functionality of decentralized networks , acting as a safeguard against the risk of numerous smaller nodes shutting down simultaneously.
